state.objective: Fix SQL injection vulnerability in user search filter.

context.content: Security audit finding SEC-402: parameter query in /api/v1/users/search vulnerable to SQLi
tenant_id header parsed from JWT bearer token

submitted_answer.answer: Use SQLite placeholders for both the tenant ID and the search pattern, then return the fetched rows.
